Inside the ML Layer at a Glance: Eight Layers from Agent to Kernel

The machine-learning software of an AI factory on one page: the eight layers between a user's request and the GPU, the open tools and in-house systems at each, the numbers that matter, where each layer gets stuck, and a guided trace of one request through the whole stack. Everything links to the eight-part series.
